mapper.select: SELECT * FROM data_quality_rule WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO data_quality_report ( rule_id, checked_at, measured_value, violation, detail, notified ) VALUES ( #{ruleId}, COALESCE(#{checkedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{measuredValue}, #{violation}, #{detail}, COALESCE(#{notified}, FALSE) )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM data_quality_report WHERE rule_id = #{ruleId} ORDER BY checked_at DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE data_quality_rule SET target_table = #{targetTable}, target_column = #{targetColumn}, rule_type = #{ruleType}, threshold = #{threshold}, range_min = #{rangeMin}, range_max = #{rangeMax}, severity = #{severity}, status = #{status}, schedule_cron = #{scheduleCron}, description = #{description}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM data_quality_report WHERE rule_id = #{ruleId}
mapper.update: UPDATE data_quality_report SET notified = TRUE WHERE id = #{id}
